msg: Biometric identifier captured with no written-release gate anywhere in this file. BIPA 15(b) requires a signed written release BEFORE collection.
The consent check runs after the capture call. BIPA 15(b) requires the written release before the identifier is collected, not after.
No retention or destruction constant in a file that captures biometrics. BIPA 15(a) requires a written schedule for permanent destruction.
Declared retention exceeds the BIPA outer limit of 3 years (1095 days) after the last interaction.
Declared retention exceeds the Texas CUBI limit of 1 year (365 days) after the purpose expires.
A hardcoded enrolment date is already past the BIPA 3-year destruction window as of the audit date.
Biometric template written to storage with no encryption on or above this line. BIPA 15(e) requires the same care as other confidential data.
Biometric template leaves the process in a network call. BIPA 15(d) bars disclosure without a separate, specific consent.
Code path sells, licenses or monetises biometric data. BIPA 15(c) bars profiting from it, with or without consent.
Emotion or affect inference from a biometric signal. Prohibited in workplace and education contexts in the EU since 2 February 2025.
Biometric categorisation inferring race, religion, political views or sexual orientation. Prohibited in the EU since 2 February 2025.
Untargeted scraping of facial images to build a dataset. Prohibited in the EU since 2 February 2025.
Employee-facing biometric capture with no notice or consent record. Colorado has required both since 1 July 2025.
No publicly available biometric retention policy referenced in this file. BIPA 15(a) requires that policy to be public.
